name: Proxy Geometry Compression
aliases: Retained-Mode Rendering with Proxy Geometry Compression
Retained-mode scheme with proxy geometry compression
definition: A scheme to store volume data and proxy geometry locally in graphics hardware to avoid CPU-GPU bandwidth bottlenecks, using compression to fit within limited memory.
summary: Proxy Geometry Compression stores pre-loaded, compressed proxy geometry in GPU memory to eliminate CPU-GPU bandwidth bottlenecks, enabling significantly faster interactive volume rendering than immediate-mode splatting.
